summary: xAI announced that Grok and X Premium subscribers can now use Grok models, including grok-build-0.1, inside the Warp terminal-based development environment.

practices.reason: Engineering teams using Warp can now connect an existing SuperGrok subscription and switch models, a concrete setup step that changes the integration surface.
practices.quote: Open the "Agent > Warp Agent" settings page and click "Connect SuperGrok subscription" Switch to the grok-build-0.1 model and start prompting.
